subject: When the current development version of ggplot2 will be released to CRAN?

messages.author: 9d162dfa682d2d99
messages.subject: When the current development version of ggplot2 will be released to CRAN?
parts:
Dear all,

I am working on a package that depends on ggplot2.

I noticed that you have made changes in the way some ggplot2 functions operate.

With these changes (applied on the dev version of ggplot2) I had new errors in my package. 
They are now fixed and working normally. 

I would like to know if you have a predicted date to release the new stable version to CRAN?

I am asking this because this will be our first submission of this package to CRAN and we want to avoid our functions to break when you update ggplot2.

Depending on that we will wait a new ggplot release to check that everything is running ok before we submit our package.

Thanks in advance,
Gustavo Paterno

messages.subject: Re: When the current development version of ggplot2 will be released to CRAN?
parts:
Hadley Wickham, the package maintainer, may or may not see this
message. If you don't get a response I'd suggest file a GitHub issue
with this question (https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/issues) or reach
out to him on Twitter (@HadleyWickham).
Ben

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: When the current development version of ggplot2 will be released to CRAN?
parts:
I'm preparing for a release at the moment. This means:

* No new features can be added between now and release, but I'll
continue to fix bugs.

* On Friday, I'll run R CMD check on all reverse dependencies and
notify maintainers of problems

* ggplot2 will be submitted to CRAN on around November 16

Hadley
